test_shuffle_select_fuzz: test the shuffle_select_fuzz_tester CLI to generate LLVM IR fuzzing tests for shufflevector and select instructions
build_shufflevector_test: build LLVM IR with random shufflevector instructions and optional select instructions for fuzz testing
run_select_fuzz_test: run the fuzz tester with a specific seed, type, and element count to generate shuffle-select IR tests
generate_vector_type: generate a random or specified vector type (i8, i16, i32, i64, f32, f64) with configurable element count
create_shuffle_select_ir: create shufflevector and select IR instructions with random masks and undef elements for LLVM fuzz testing
